categories.label: Strictly necessary
categories.description: Needed for the site to work — serving the app, remembering your answers on your own device, and security. These are always active and cannot be switched off, and require no consent. They set no third-party cookies: the contact form, feedback widget and survey are protected by Cloudflare Turnstile, which is cookieless and runs only when you submit one of them.

categories.label: Analytics
categories.description: Help us understand, in aggregate, how the tool is used so we can improve it. Off unless you turn them on. Data is aggregated and never used to identify you, and turning this off changes nothing about your card.

services.name: Formspree
services.purpose: Delivers the feedback widget and contact form to us. Only processes what you type into those forms, and only when you submit one; it is never used for tracking.

services.name: Cloudflare Turnstile
services.purpose: Protects the contact form, feedback widget and survey from spam and automated abuse. It is cookieless and non-interactive (no puzzle to solve) and runs only when you submit one of them, returning a token we verify to drop automated submissions. The survey uses a separate Turnstile widget from the forms, so a survey submission shares neither configuration nor per-widget analytics with a form submission. It is never used for advertising or cross-site tracking.
services.dataLocation: Global — Cloudflare edge network; may be processed outside Australia.

infrastructure.name: Cloudflare
infrastructure.role: Website hosting and CDN (Cloudflare Pages), edge compute (Pages Functions), the consented research counter database (Cloudflare D1), cookieless aggregate usage measurement (Cloudflare Web Analytics, measured at the edge with no client tag or cookie), the Turnstile anti-abuse challenge, and edge security including rate limiting and Bot Fight Mode. The site is served from our own origin through Cloudflare; the only browser-loaded Cloudflare surface is the Turnstile challenge on form or survey submit (declared as its own service), so this infrastructure entry adds no Content-Security-Policy source.
infrastructure.dataProcessing: Serves all site content and runs the /api/research endpoints. Stores consented aggregate research counters in Cloudflare D1. Measures aggregate site usage with cookieless Cloudflare Web Analytics (no per-person identifier). May process request metadata (including IP address) transiently for delivery and security; the application does not read, log or persist it.
infrastructure.retention: Operational hosting: for the life of the service. Research data: aggregate-only counters retained per docs/privacy/retention.md (no per-person record exists). Cloudflare's own transient network/security logs per its data-processing terms.
infrastructure.dataLocation: Global — Cloudflare edge network; may be processed outside Australia.

contract.note: Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum + self-serve terms to be reviewed and filed in the restricted legal records; evidence pending (fail-closed / partial-passing) — no approval is asserted here.

infrastructure.name: GitHub
infrastructure.role: Source-code hosting, pull-request review and continuous integration via GitHub Actions. The deployed site does not contact GitHub at runtime.
infrastructure.dataProcessing: Stores the repository, issues, pull requests and CI logs, and processes contributor account data under GitHub's terms. No end-user personal data from the site flows to GitHub.
infrastructure.retention: Repository and CI history retained for the life of the project; GitHub Actions logs per GitHub defaults.
infrastructure.dataLocation: United States and global — Microsoft/GitHub infrastructure.

contract.note: GitHub Customer Terms + Data Protection Agreement to be reviewed and filed; evidence pending (fail-closed / partial-passing).

infrastructure.name: They Vote For You
infrastructure.role: Source of parliamentary voting-record data (party positions) via the They Vote For You API, retrieved at data-build time and compiled into the dataset. The deployed site does not contact this service at runtime.
infrastructure.dataProcessing: Public parliamentary voting-record data is retrieved from the API and compiled into the dataset. No end-user personal data is sent to the OpenAustralia Foundation.
infrastructure.retention: Raw API snapshots retained in-repo as provenance under data/source/<election>/; no personal data is involved.
infrastructure.subprocessorsNote: The OpenAustralia Foundation is a volunteer-run non-profit and publishes no formal subprocessor list. The data retrieved is public parliamentary records; no personal data is disclosed to it.

contract.note: They Vote For You API terms and ODbL-1.0 data licence to be reviewed and filed; evidence pending (fail-closed / partial-passing).

antiAbuse.note: Turnstile runs in its non-interactive/invisible mode when a form or the survey is submitted; it never presents a visual or audio puzzle the user must solve, so it imposes no interactive challenge and no accessibility barrier. The survey uses a separate Turnstile widget/secret from the forms. (Managed mode, which can show a checkbox, is deliberately not used — it would make this interactive.)

antiAbuse.mechanism: Edge rate limiting + Bot Fight Mode
antiAbuse.note: Server-side rate limiting and heuristic bot mitigation on POST /api/research. It is applied at the edge and presents no user-facing challenge, so it is accessible to all users.
